mode.title: Mode
mode.description: odds: price a named list of fixtures. events: list what SportyBet currently carries, for discovery and for verifying tournament ids.

fixtures.title: Fixtures
fixtures.description: Fixtures to price (odds mode). Each needs homeTeam and awayTeam; kickoff is strongly recommended, since it gates which SportyBet events are even considered. Supply eventId when a previous run already resolved it to skip matching entirely.

competitions.title: Competitions
competitions.description: Competition keys to list in events mode, or "all" for the catalog. Leave empty for SportyBet's entire football slate.

windowDays.title: Window (days)
windowDays.description: How far ahead to list events in events mode. SportyBet itself carries roughly four weeks.

matching.title: Matching thresholds
matching.description: Overrides for fixture resolution. kickoffToleranceMinutes gates candidates by kickoff; minNameScore is the floor each team name must clear; minCombinedScore is the floor for their average; minMargin is how far clear of the runner-up the winner must be before a match is accepted rather than reported ambiguous.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel event fetches. Each matched fixture costs one request.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. Datacenter proxies are sufficient; the API is unauthenticated JSON.
